name: 3a (CHF 100,000) and BVG (CHF 200,000) lump sums in the same year, Lugano
workings: Ticino: 300,000 × 50.77 per 1,000 = 15,231, rounded down to 15,200; tax 20 + 5.232% × 2,700 = 161.26, a rate of 1.06%, so the 2% floor: simple 6,000; cantonal 6,000, communal 4,800.
Separately (100,000 at 64, 200,000 at 65): 4,136.888 + 9,780.688 = 13,917.576, a saving of 2,103.112, all federal: in Ticino capital benefits up to about 378,000 a year pay a flat 2% simple tax.
